messages:
maria: Kicking off staged rollout for model-service v3.2.1 -> 10% in eu-west during quiet window (02:00-04:00 UTC). DeployBot: starting traffic shift.
alex: noted quiet window. SLOs to watch: p95 < 120ms, error_rate < 0.5%. I'll monitor traces.
deploy-bot: /shift traffic 10% -> v3.2.1 (eu-west) — initiated by @maria
infra-bot: canary telemetry (1m): p95=98ms, error_rate=0.12%, kv_miss=3%
jordan: seeing a slow tail on streaming responses — a small subset at ~450-500ms, not seen in staging. Rate ~2% of requests.
sara: can we hold at 10% until we surface traces? slow tail worries me. :eyes:
maria: holding. pausing further shifts. pin fallback version v3.1.9 in eu-west while we triage.
deploy-bot: /pin route /generate -> v3.1.9 in eu-west (manual pin by @maria)
alex: rollback-readiness checklist: warm caches, run replay, ensure rollout playbook ready. I can run replay now.
ops-oncall: I can run a controlled replay against canary traces and attach flamegraphs.
maria: please do. hold for 15m and post top 50 slow traces. DeployBot: confirm traffic shift paused.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused at 10% (manual hold by @maria). No further automated ramp.
jordan: attaching trace example: ```json
{"trace_id":"abc123","span":"kv_lookup","latency_ms":480}
```
sara: kv_miss seems elevated compared to baseline. looks like cache warming/regeneration issue. flagged as flaky behavior; recommend not moving to 20% until root cause identified.
maria: decision: hold. Rollback criteria: if error_rate > 0.8% or p95 > 250ms sustained for 5m -> rollback to v3.1.9. Otherwise, proceed to 20% after green from infra.
alex: acknowledged. I'll dump top traces and follow up with sampling results.
infra-bot: telemetry (5m window): p95=210ms, error_rate=0.55%, kv_miss=12% (eu-west canary slice)
maria: thanks. quiet window ends in ~8m. prioritizing rollback readiness.
jordan: starting controlled rollback dry-run steps (no traffic switch) to validate playbook.
deploy-bot: /rollback v3.2.1 -> v3.1.9 (eu-west) — initiated by @maria (estimated 2m)
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic now 100% -> v3.1.9 in eu-west.
maria: confirmed rollback succeeded. opening INF-2345 for slow-tail + kv-cache warming investigation. We'll re-run canary after fix and rehearse a warm-cache rollout plan. :wave:
alex: thanks everyone. Postmortem note: pause was correct call given telemetry. I'll attach traces to the ticket.
sara: +1. recommend we add an automated kv-cache warmup check to rollout gating.
ops-oncall: closing replay job, uploading artifacts to the ticket.
maria: closing thread — follow-up in INF-2345 and next deploy window.
